criteria.requirement: Add packaging.display.DisplayVersion as an immutable standalone display wrapper, not a change to Version internals. Construct from exact text, expose raw_version and parsed version, normalize str while display preserves exact spelling, comparison/order/hash only use Version semantics (also with plain Version). from_version represents derived/from_parts/replaced versions with raw_version=None and normalized display. Preserve pickle round trips, reject invalid versions and mutation. No raw spelling in canonical comparison keys or original Version pickle formats.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
